meta.title: Questionnaire templates | Invessiv
meta.description: Maintain the building blocks and templates for questionnaires, such as project onboarding.

catalog.title: Questionnaire templates
catalog.description: Blocks are the steps of a questionnaire; templates combine them for one purpose, such as onboarding a type of project. Changes here only affect new forms.

blocks.caption: Blocks
blocks.carryOverHint: Pre-filled from the last form in the next project

empty.title: No blocks yet
empty.description: Blocks are the sections of a questionnaire, such as “Company” or “Logos & corporate design”. Create the first one and add fields to it.

noResults.title: No block matches the filter
noResults.description: Change the search or include archived blocks.

empty.title: No templates yet
empty.description: A template sets which blocks a form gets and in which order, for example for a compact landing page.

noResults.title: No template matches the filter
noResults.description: Change the search or include archived templates.

createBlockDialog.title: New block
createBlockDialog.description: Title and key now; fields and more languages afterwards in the editor.

hints.key: Internal name of lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Suggested from the title.
hints.carryOver: Content applies to the whole company and is pre-filled in the next project.

createTemplateDialog.title: New template
createTemplateDialog.description: You choose the blocks afterwards in the template editor.

hints.description: When does this template fit? Only visible internally.

validation.key: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores only, starting with a letter, at least two characters.
validation.minChoices: This choice needs at least two options.

blockPage.deleteBlockedHint: Used in templates, so it can only be archived.

duplicateDialog.title: Duplicate block
duplicateDialog.description: The copy takes over all fields, options and texts. You edit it afterwards in the editor.

deleteDialog.title: Delete block?
deleteDialog.description: “{name}” is deleted with all its fields. Existing forms keep their copy.

head.title: Title
head.introHint: Optional. Tells the customer briefly what this step is about.
head.carryOverHint: Pre-filled from the last completed form in the next project.

locales.missingDescription: This language is not maintained yet. The portal then shows the first available language.

empty.title: No fields yet
empty.description: Fields are the questions of this step. Create the first one, for example a text, a choice or a file upload.

fields.groupEmpty: This group has no sub-fields yet. Every entry of the customer asks for them.

fieldDialog.typeFixed: The type is fixed once the field exists.
fieldDialog.keyHint: Internal name, unique in this block. Suggested from the question.
fieldDialog.requiredHint: Only applies while the field is visible.
fieldDialog.label: Question
fieldDialog.helpHint: Optional. Tell the customer why we need this.

itemsHint.files: Number of files. Leave empty for no limit.
itemsHint.group: Number of entries. Leave empty for no limit.
itemsHint.multi_choice: Number of chosen options. Leave empty for no limit.

fieldDialog.acceptedKindsHint: None selected means all file types.
fieldDialog.prefillHint: The customer sees the value from the CRM and can change it. Nothing is written back to the CRM.
fieldDialog.conflict: Someone changed this block in the meantime. The current state is loaded and your input is still here. Check it and save again.

choices.label: Label ({language})
choices.fixedHint: The options of this type are fixed; only the labels can change.

condition.noCandidates: Conditions need a choice or yes/no field further up on the same level.

deleteDialog.title: Delete field?
deleteDialog.description: “{name}” is deleted from this block. Existing forms keep their copy.
deleteDialog.descriptionGroup: “{name}” is deleted from this block with all its sub-fields. Existing forms keep their copy.

editor.conflict: Someone changed this block in the meantime. The current state is loaded; please repeat your change.

head.title: Title
head.descriptionHint: When does this template fit? Only visible internally.

blocks.empty: This template has no blocks yet. Add them in the order the customer fills them in.
blocks.archivedHint: Stays in the template but cannot be added again.

picker.title: Add block
picker.description: Only active blocks that are not in the template yet.
picker.empty: All active blocks are already in the template.

templateEditor.conflict: Someone changed this template in the meantime. The current state is loaded and your input is still here. Check it and save again.

errors.QUESTIONNAIRE_FIELD_NOT_FOUND: The field no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.QUESTIONNAIRE_TRANSLATION_REQUIRED: At least one language needs a text.
errors.QUESTIONNAIRE_INVALID_CONDITION: The condition no longer fits: a field or option is still used by a condition, or the trigger would sit behind the dependent field.
errors.QUESTIONNAIRE_INVALID_FIELD_CONFIG: The settings do not fit the field type. Check options and limits.
errors.QUESTIONNAIRE_BLOCK_IN_USE: The block is part of a template and can only be archived.
errors.QUESTIONNAIRE_CHOICE_IN_USE: The customer already chose an option you removed or gave a new key. Keep it, or the answer would be lost.
errors.QUESTIONNAIRE_LAST_FIELD: The last field of a block or group stays while the form is with the customer. Add another field first.
errors.QUESTIONNAIRE_LIMIT_REACHED: A limit is reached, such as the number of fields or options.
errors.QUESTIONNAIRE_NOT_EDITABLE: The structure is fixed by now and can no longer be changed. Reload the page.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: The input is incomplete or invalid.
errors.INTERNAL: That did not work. Please try again in a moment.
